scope: preflight of one approved read-only frozen-mount metadata collection
status: blocked before SSH by two reviewed local collector deadline defects

independentReview.method: read-only static review; no execution or network

findings.description: Metadata sampling can approach 18 seconds before a new three-second command budget is opened; signal-triggered cleanup can outlive the intended remote twenty-second envelope.
TimeoutError inherits OSError, so the metadata error branch can demote an alarm timeout to a path observation and continue after the one-shot alarm has fired.

otherObservations: Only metadata, link text and fixed systemctl outputs are requested.
Leaf lstat is no-follow, but intermediate path components can resolve symbolic links.
Two observations are not an atomic metadata snapshot.
Prior library tests do not cover this newly generated wrapper.

items: Use one shared deadline and refuse a final query when insufficient cleanup reserve remains.
Propagate timeout/cancellation instead of converting it to metadata errors.
Add local fault-injection regression for near-deadline and alarm-during-metadata branches; update source/request/binding digests.
